title: Scan intake
instructions: Read the scan header and the files in /inputs: voxel spacing, size, orientation, and any problem with the data. Write what you found for the later tasks, and the notes' account of the field in /outputs/intake/scan-notes.md (scan-intake skill).
doneWhen: The spacing and size come from the files themselves, with the file or header each came from.

title: Orientation
instructions: Orient the stack so the later tasks share one frame (a labels-ready volume with known axes), with the orient-joint skill.
doneWhen: The orientation is checked on a render you looked at.

title: Segmentation
instructions: Segment the bones and joint structures and settle the final labels; a piece the data do not support is not named, and whether its structure is absent is decided by the segmentation-check skill, section 2.
doneWhen: Every label is one structure, checked on renders and component counts.
The volumes of #1-3 follow from the final labels.

title: Tibial IIOC
instructions: Define the IIOC region (ROI-1) and report its volumes, heights and the tibial width.
doneWhen: ROI-1 runs from the growth plate to the articular surface and was checked on a render.

title: Subchondral bone plate
instructions: Measure the subchondral bone plate thickness, medial and lateral.
doneWhen: Each thickness is reported with the render it was read from.

title: IIOC trabecular bone
instructions: Define ROI-2 (ROI-1 without the plate and the cortical line) and report its volumes.
doneWhen: ROI-2 excludes the subchondral plate and the cortical line.

title: Proximal tibial metaphysis
instructions: Define ROI-3 below the growth plate and report its trabecular parameters.
doneWhen: ROI-3 starts 50 um below the growth plate, is 200 um long and 20 um clear of cortical bone.

title: Tibial cortical thickness
instructions: Measure the cortical thickness 100 um and 1000 um below the growth plate. Use the cortex mask and distal growth-plate face that metaphyseal-roi wrote (/outputs/metaphyseal-roi/meta/cortex.npy and /outputs/metaphyseal-roi/meta/growth-plate-distal-face.npy); do not trace the face again.
doneWhen: Both levels are measured on the cortex mask and distal face of metaphyseal-roi.

title: Distal femur
instructions: Place the femoral points and report the distal femoral length, width and their ratio.
doneWhen: Points a-d are placed on renders and the lengths follow from them.
